eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Lane, OR; at 5:01 PM on AUG 10, 2021 Effective until 9:01 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an emergency notice from Oakridge Fire.  The following areas and neighborhoods are being issued a Level 2  BE SET  Evacuation notice due to wildfire: High Prairie, Fish Hatchery, Oakridge north of Roberts Road, and Oakridge east of Salmon Creek. Level 2 means everyone in the identified area should be ready to evacuate at a moments notice. Again High Prairie, Fish Hatchery, Oakridge north of Roberts Road, and Oakridge east of Salmon Creek are at Level 2 (BE SET). This may be your last warning.  More information at www.lanecountyor.gov.
